title: pinus tabuliformis var. pygmaea
intro: Pinus tabuliformis var. pygmaea, commonly known as the Korean pine, is a small to medium-sized evergreen tree native to the mountainous regions of East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects that can help to improve cardiovascular health, boost the immune system, and reduce the risk of certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Pinus tabuliformis var. pygmaea include stimulating the production of white blood cells, reducing inflammation and pain, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anticancer activities.
